integrity: Analytical derivation and reproducible deterministic checks; no claim of independent verification or broader parameter generality.
scientific_limitations: The sharp moment coefficients require independent centered inner errors, a bounded outer density continuous and positive at the kink, and the stated moments; limits use even sample counts.
The exact finite-sample half-normal-difference law additionally assumes Gaussian outer and inner variables.
Pilot zero-event law requires independent outer replications and does not prescribe a complete multilevel allocation.
Publication priority has not been independently validated; full text of a relevant 2020 initial-margin study was not available.
title: Sharp rare-event and moment laws for antithetic nested Monte Carlo at a kink
